message.content:
Create 25 NEW specialized agent files for QuizSnap (Shopify Product Recommendation Quiz Builder). These are completely new agents that don't exist yet. Each must be autonomous, intelligent, and production-grade.

Stack: React Router 7, Polaris v13, Prisma v6, App Bridge v4, TypeScript strict, Vite v6

Format for each:
```markdown
---
name: agent-name
description: [specific trigger keywords for auto-detection]
model: sonnet
---
[150-200 lines of content]
```

Each agent must have:
- AUTO-DETECT: specific trigger patterns
- DECISION TREE: autonomous logic
- Full TypeScript code examples
- SPAWN AGENTS: which agents to coordinate
- Self-validation checklist (10+ items)
- Never rules

---

## 1. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/.claude/agents/graphql-specialist.md`

description: "Use when writing Shopify Admin API GraphQL queries/mutations, building product queries, order queries, customer queries, or fixing GraphQL errors. Triggered by: graphql, query, mutation, shopify api, products query, admin api, gid, rate limit"

Content: 
- Shopify GraphQL patterns for React Router 7 (`admin.graphql()` pattern)
- All QuizSnap-relevant queries: products, orders, customers, discounts, collections
- Mutation patterns: discountCodeBasicCreate, stagedUploadsCreate, flowTriggerReceive  
- Cursor-based pagination pattern (complete implementation)
- Rate limit handling (exponential backoff, cost checking)
- GID format handling (encode/decode)
- Error checking pattern (check `userErrors`, not just HTTP status)
- GraphQL fragments for reusable fields

---

## 2. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/.claude/agents/form-validator.md`

description: "Use when adding form validation, Zod schemas, input sanitization, or building validated forms. Triggered by: validation, form validation, zod schema, input validation, sanitize, required field, validate email, validate url"

Content:
- Zod schema library for all QuizSnap forms (quiz create, question edit, settings, integrations)
- Server-side validation in actions
- Client-side validation with Polaris error states
- Validation error display pattern (field-level errors with Polaris TextField error prop)
- Sanitization patterns (strip HTML, trim strings, normalize emails)

---

## 3. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/.claude/agents/pagination-builder.md`

description: "Use when implementing list pagination, infinite scroll, cursor-based pagination, or load-more patterns. Triggered by: pagination, paginate, load more, infinite scroll, cursor, page size, next page"

Content:
- Cursor-based pagination for quiz responses (could be millions of rows)
- URL-based pagination state (search params)
- Polaris pagination controls
- Database pagination query pattern (take/skip vs cursor)
- Full implementation for app.quizzes.tsx and analytics tables

---

Content:
